digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation; CI reliability, documentation, and code quality
propositions: CI test_opcert_service_app worker dies intermittently under xdist on Python 3.11 due to a load-dependent pytest teardown race condition (OSError at worker shutdown)
User-facing documentation teaches an assignee example inconsistent with docs/config.md and Jira resolution

Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py mix responsibilities across layers and duplicate infrastructure, requiring structural decomposition by responsibility with preserved public import paths

Graph-related functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity driven by duplicated BFS traversal logic that should be centralized
The attest package lacks type annotations required for mypy --disallow-untyped-defs enforcement
